title: AuditFinding
description: A single audit claim produced by a Stage-1 reviewer subagent. The Stage-2 verifier consumes this and independently reproduces (or fails to reproduce) the repro_check.

id.description: Reviewer-local ID (e.g., R3-F2). Orchestrator rewrites to global F-NNN after dedupe.

claim.description: Specific claim. Must be precise enough that a verifier with no prior context can decide it.

evidence.description: What the reviewer observed. Quoted DOM snippet, file content, screenshot description, etc. The verifier will NOT trust this — they re-observe independently.

repro_check.description: The reproducibility contract. The verifier executes this and judges whether the claim is observable. Findings without a coherent repro_check are auto-discarded before Stage 2.

type.description: Which verification primitive applies. playwright_* → web target; file_*/command → code/doc target.

input.description: URL (playwright_*), file path (file_*), or shell command (command).

expected.description: What an adversarial verifier should observe to consider the claim VERIFIED. Be specific. Bad: 'page looks broken'. Good: 'querySelector(\"nav a[href=/akut]\") returns null OR computed color contrast < 4.5:1 on .vsm-hero h1'.

selector.description: (playwright_dom/_visual/_a11y only) CSS selector or ARIA query for the element under test.

viewport.description: (playwright_* only) Viewport for verification. Default 375x812 (iPhone reference).

suggested_fix.description: Optional. Not used by the verifier. Surfaced in report.md if verdict=verified.
